 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Serbia are at home to face Germany tonight, Friday, November 13, at Stadion Rajko Mitić in Belgrade, and both teams need something from this one in the Nations League. Kick-off is 8:45 p.m. CET, which is 2:45 p.m. ET in the USA.
 Germany are the healthier side in  League A, Group 2 . They're third on 5 points from four games, with one win, two draws and one loss. Serbia are bottom, beaten in all four and still on zero.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Germany won the first meeting 2-0 and will want to do the same away from home to stay in the hunt near the top.
 For Serbia, playing in front of their own fans is a chance to hit back after a rough start. They need points to get off the bottom, and another defeat would leave them in real trouble.
